sql_templates.description: Fetch outcomes for signals issued in the last 3 months.
sql_templates.name: fetch_signal_outcomes
sql_templates.template:
SELECT 
                    s.symbol, 
                    s.signal, 
                    s.date_issued, 
                    s.date_resolved, 
                    s.hit_target, 
                    s.hit_stop, 
                    s.return_pct
                FROM 
                    signals.signal_log s
                WHERE 
                    s.date_issued >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months')
                ORDER BY 
                    s.date_issued DESC
                LIMIT 50;

WITH latest_results AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (symbol) symbol, period_end, revenue, pat, opm_pct

sql_templates.description: Fetch FII/DII flows, regime history, and market breadth for the latest quarter.
sql_templates.name: MarketAnalysisQuery
sql_templates.query:
WITH latest_trades AS (SELECT MAX(trade_date) AS latest_date FROM market.index_eod),
flow_info AS (SELECT f.trade_date, f.fii_net_today, f.dii_net_today, f.flow_signal,
r.regime, r.confidence, r.days_in_regime,
b.advances, b.declines, b.ad_signal
FROM signals.fii_dii_flows f
JOIN signals.regime_history r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date
JOIN breadth.market_daily b ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date
WHERE f.trade_date > (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months')),
index_info AS (SELECT i.trade_date, i.index_symbol, i.close FROM market.index_eod i
WHERE i.trade_date = (SELECT latest_date FROM latest_trades)
AND i.index_symbol = 'Nifty 50')
SELECT flow_info.*, index_info.close FROM flow_info
LEFT JOIN index_info ON flow_info.trade_date = index_info.trade_date

synthesis_guidance: Summarize only validated evidence, surface missing evidence, and keep research-only framing.
